Gas use intensity of 6 kWh/m2 a year (1.8 kBtu/ft2) is below the 5th percentile of gas-using offices of 50,000 to 199,999 ft2 nationally (CBECS2018); 80 percent of them use 14 to 119 kWh/m2. Check the model before relying on it: this office's gas is a lower bound. The model treats the space as one zone, so the heat of the core, the lights and the equipment offsets the perimeter's heat loss; it does not model office water heating; and a suite with no roof or ground floor loses less heat than the whole buildings surveyed. Gas savings in the plan are understated, and the utility bills would calibrate it. Compared with national instead of the climate zone, because the closer cut has fewer than 50 surveyed buildings.
